alojamiento.a: Yes. Pets are allowed on request. Supplement: €10 per pet, per stay (terms published on Booking.com).
There are 8 bungalows, sleeping up to 16 adults. Children depend on the set-up of each booking.

alojamiento.q: What is included in the stay?
alojamiento.a: Breakfast, Wi-Fi, air conditioning, a porch, and access to shared areas and the swimming pool.

alojamiento.q: How do I book a bungalow?
alojamiento.a: The most direct route is Booking.com, with live availability. You can also write on WhatsApp or use the form; we always check the Booking.com calendar before confirming.

alojamiento.q: Can we take the whole estate?
alojamiento.a: Yes. The Events page lists exclusive-use options, with or without accommodation, and a weekend option.
Booking.com’s policy, which is the one we apply: free cancellation on rates that say so. The exact deadline is on your confirmation. See the Booking policy page.

alojamiento.q: How far is it from Madrid?
alojamiento.a: The estate is in Villamanrique, Ciudad Real. About 247 km and 3 h 25 min by car from Madrid (OSRM / OpenStreetMap, 19 Oct 2026, from Villamanrique village).

la-calerilla.a: The usual season runs from October to February. Dates should be requested well in advance as demand is high.

la-calerilla.q: Which types of shooting are offered?
la-calerilla.a: The main discipline is walked-up red-legged partridge shooting. Driven partridge days are also available. TODO_DATO: any other disciplines.
Shooting days are organised by Alectoris Ibérica SL.

la-calerilla.q: Can shooting be combined with lodging?
la-calerilla.a: Yes. You can combine a day in the field with bungalows and dining at Finca Los Collados de San Miguel.

la-calerilla.q: How do I book a shooting day?
la-calerilla.a: Via WhatsApp or the La Calerilla form, with preferred dates and the number of guns.

eventos.q: How many people can an event hold?
eventos.a: Outdoor celebrations for up to 50 guests. Overnight lodging on the estate is for 16 adults in 8 bungalows.

eventos.q: Can we hire the whole estate?
eventos.a: Yes, with or without lodging, and there is a weekend option. Price on request.

eventos.q: How do I book an event?
eventos.a: WhatsApp or the form, with dates, guest numbers and the type of celebration. Events are not booked as a Booking.com room stay.

empresas.q: What kind of company is the estate for?
empresas.a: SMEs and teams looking for team building, retreats, film shoots or photo sessions in a private La Mancha setting.

empresas.q: How many people can a team lodge?
empresas.a: Up to 16 adults in 8 bungalows. The estate can host larger groups for daytime activity. TODO_DATO: exact indoor/outdoor capacity.

empresas.q: Can we film or shoot stills?
empresas.a: Yes. There is a specific option for photo shoots / film and photo shoots and for hiring spaces for production.

empresas.q: Can a company take the whole estate?
empresas.a: Yes. That is the usual option when full privacy is required.

empresas.q: How do we request a quote?
empresas.a: WhatsApp or the form, with dates, team size and the type of activity (team building, retreat or shoot).
